goals: Provide correct, fail-closed Xaero entity-head icons for Ribbits through a distinct compatibility companion without changing normal Ribbits rendering or the accepted Xaero × EMF Canary 3 behavior.
Implement a reusable Xaero × GeckoLib icon-capture core with explicit opt-in entity selectors, using a Ribbits-specific face/core selector only where exact model structure supports it.
Preserve exact-version, cache, render-state, resource-reload, transform, private-asset, and All Rights Reserved boundaries established by the audit before producing any runtime candidate.
scope: Intercept Xaero's model-icon path at or before its null vanilla-EntityModel failure for supported GeckoLib renderers, while leaving vanilla, EMF, and unsupported renderer paths unchanged.

Reuse one fully populated GeckoLib render-state snapshot to resolve model and profession texture, select only explicitly approved direct face/core geometry with inherited transforms, and rasterize it through an isolated icon-only path.

Provide Ribbits model/provider metadata that accounts for nine professions, transient instrument and umbrella/rain selection, Pride policy, baby scaling, cache identity, and resource reload without copying private models or textures.
Fail closed to Xaero's ordinary failed-icon dot/name behavior on version drift, missing data, missing or ambiguous selectors, structural drift, invalid transforms, or rendering failure.

exclusions: Changes to projects/xaero-entity-icons or its accepted/current Canary 3 source, tests, artifacts, releases, lifecycle, runtime evidence, or documented EMF-only scope.
Changes to projects/ribbits-26.2, its renderer, private resources, artifacts, releases, lifecycle, or runtime evidence.
A dummy vanilla EntityModel or ModelPart facade, whole-body Gecko capture, mutation or replay of the in-world renderer, or a generic head-bone name heuristic.
Redistribution of Xaero All Rights Reserved code/assets, private or donor-derived Ribbits models/textures/manifests, decompiled upstream class bodies, or unlicensed static icon art.
Production implementation, a build or successor compatibility artifact, deployment, Minecraft launch, Test Slot A or B use, accepted-baseline mutation, or runtime validation in this audit revision.
Modification of the dedicated Workbench profile, runtime-manager state, originals, or any access to the protected Matcha Flavoured 26.1.2 gameplay instance.

state.milestone: Static audit proves Xaero 26.4.2 returns FAILED when its vanilla EntityModel extractor receives Ribbits' GeckoLib GeoEntityRenderer, before accepted EMF Canary 3 can run. A distinct generic Geo-aware bridge with an opt-in Ribbits selector is warranted; no runtime candidate exists and the user's historical Ribbits artifact remains unbound.
